title: [Bug] Bolus progress bar disappears prematurely
body:
After upgrading to 3.3.1.3, I noticed that with larger boluses, the progress bar disappears before the bolus is finished.

Please have a look at the recorded video:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e6ba4a73-51e0-48b2-9f9b-ce625f0a40ff

This is the corresponding log:

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18664469/AndroidAPS.log)

As shown in the video, the bolus is delivered as calculated, so it's a display issue only.
